one_liner: NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook) has an official v1alpha REST API only via Gemini Notebook Enterprise on Google Cloud (paid licenses, 15 minimum, OAuth user token); personal accounts get no official API and only third-party MCP/workarounds exist.
access_notes: Calls require an authenticated user account with an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license in a Google Cloud project. Listed at $9/license/month with a 15-license minimum after a 30-day trial (another page cites a 14-day trial, so terms are unclear). The pages do not confirm any free personal-account API; they say personal accounts have no official API.
blocker_notes: Enterprise licenses (15 minimum), Cloud project setup, IdP/IAM roles are required. API is v1alpha (Pre-GA), about 11 methods, and cannot chat with a notebook. Consumer accounts have nothing official; workarounds can break.
